children: Li Auto, Inc. Sponsored ADR Class A (HKEX:2015) rode a near 4.5% ADR bump after launching the six‑seat BEV SUV Li i9 as it reported Q2 2026 revenue decline and EPS loss but growing non‑vehicle revenue, delivered 406,000 vehicles in 2025, and teased refreshed Li i6 and tech sales plans.
Li Auto Begins Li i9 Deliveries
: Li Auto began China deliveries of the six‑seat BEV SUV Li i9, priced at RMB 369,800. Adds BEV SUV to lineup after Li Mega MPV; company delivered 406,000 vehicles in 2025.
: Li Auto (2015) Q2 2026 revenue RMB 25.7B, down >15% YoY; non-vehicle revenue ~RMB 1.6B (+17.6%). Reported loss per share RMB 1.49, second straight quarter missing estimates.
: Li Auto (2015) will launch a refreshed Li i6 SUV in Q4 with in-house batteries and chips; pre-orders open later this month.
Li Auto Explores External Tech Sales
: Li Auto (2015) is exploring external sales of tech: Mach M100 driver chip, silicon‑carbide modules, and EV range‑extender tech. No battery sales planned; no supply deals announced.
: Li Auto ADR (LI) jumped ~4.5% intraday after the Li i9 launch news, marking a notable single-session gain in LI shares.
